family_reports.body: Audrey would argue with the judges like her word was final say. She needs fired

someone told that the attorney is the guardian ad litem, and the judge talk together outside of the support room and I didn’t believe it. It’s until I went through this case myself. It was almost like the hearings were rehearsed, my own attorney included.

I hate to admit, but I gave up because I haven’t seen anyone else win in this “good ole boy” town. I’m hoping one day my son will understand I don’t want him to have to go through watching me lose him
Scottsbluff just wants to keep funding the sick individuals who think taking kids is “in their best interest” when they have loving parents

After working for DHHS and wanting to be the person to help me make a positive change and then seeing how DHHS tore my family apart, it showed how much people care more about power and being right than what is in the right interest of children. Now as a therapist, I hope it can help others, including my own children someday heal from this trauma.
